facts.name: Japanese Anemone
facts.color: Pink or white flowers on tall stems
facts.notes: Graceful pink or white flowers float on tall stems in late summer and fall, when most of the bed is winding down. Spreads once settled.
facts.toxSrc: Buttercup family; considered poisonous to people and pets (veterinary references)

companions.why: Pair with fall aster, bugbane, eupatorium, goldenrod, sedum or toad lily; near bleeding heart; with variegated hosta and grasses.
